title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: tier upgrade and downgrade effective timing
content:
This document covers the Corporate Wellness Partnership's basis for when a change to a higher or lower partnership tier takes effect.

| Tier | An upgrade to this tier takes effect | A downgrade to this tier takes effect |
|---|---|---|
| Startup Partner | Immediately | At the next billing cycle |
| Small Business Partner | Immediately | At the next billing cycle |
| Mid-Market Partner | Immediately | At the next billing cycle |
| Enterprise Partner | Immediately | At the next billing cycle |
| Municipal Partner | At the next billing cycle | At the next billing cycle |
| Nonprofit Partner | At the next billing cycle | At the next billing cycle |

An employer moving to a tier whose upgrade timing reads 'Immediately' has that tier apply as soon as the change is made; a tier whose upgrade or downgrade timing reads 'At the next billing cycle' instead takes effect starting with the employer's next monthly billing cycle.
